clock.method: Marker is emitted after render duration measurement; match start/duration label, subtract(start+duration)*1000. Median anchor offset, not start-label or timeOrigin subtraction.
clock.uncertainty: Three anchors only; includes marker bookkeeping/scheduling overhead and performance.now quantization. Minimum overlap across recorded offsets is reported, not a guarantee beyond those anchors.
